answers.how: The person averages about 34 pixels tall, giving 1.75/34 m per pixel. The boat is approximately 276 pixels long.
The boat spans approximately 78 pixels perpendicular to its length. Using the person's scale gives 78 × 1.75/34.
Near 1.0 s, the boat moves approximately 110 pixels per second. Multiplying by 1.75/34 converts this to m/s.
Tracking the person's head near 1.0 s gives approximately 29 pixels per second. Multiplying by 1.75/34 converts this to m/s.
